review_basis: Read the complete 16-obligation Lean model, specification and type inventory; checked grammar report production IDs, source reconstruction and evidence fields against parser implementation; inspected current bootstrap, migration, psycopg and recovery call sites.

The parser exposes all derivation production IDs, while statementFamilies stops at outer statements, supporting the specified nested-form denial design. Current migration contains DO and dynamic EXECUTE and the application uses parameterized set_config, so their specified rewrites are necessary.
Reviewed prior Astra findings and revision 3 reconciliation. No new concrete unresolved design blocker found.
implementation_acceptance_notes: The Lean state model proves provenance for reachable accepted Parse/Bind states, not protocol correspondence, lifecycle or successful execution. It does not model Close, errors, unnamed invalidation, backend status or cache implementation; exercise these independently.

Build and verify a complete mapping from pinned grammar production IDs to forbidden nonterminals, including nested forms, and ensure mode checks happen before pipelined forwarding. Preserve strict source equality, identity and response checks.
Verify each actual connection path and real dump/restore independently, and exercise fresh, upgraded and partially applied migrations. Maintain failure-closed behavior with no direct fallback.
Treat the 16 obligations as abstract policy facts. Final two clean proof builds must bind this exact revision; the earlier draft report is not final evidence.
formal_limits: No independent Lean build was run in this review.
Admission flags and identity are assumptions of the abstract model, not proofs of Python wire framing, the parser subprocess, PostgreSQL behavior, or network isolation.
approval_scope: Exact revision 3 bounded implementation plan only; successful implementation, runtime acceptance and rights beyond user-authorized local use remain separate.
